config.title: LLLC+HVAC Weather Locations
config.note: Station set from Kathryn Bae's 10/29/2026 climate-zone proposal (approved by Chris Wolgamott 10/30). DOE/PNNL reference cities are the ASHRAE 90.1 prototype-model locations for each zone. Redmond and Yakima added 11/2/2026 at K. Bae's request (SE 5B gas funder area). Boise added as a second modeled 5B city (with Spokane) 11/4/2026 at NEEA's request.
